page: Amazon Web Services r9g.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. It features 192 dedicated physical cores on an arm64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides 192 vCPUs of dedicated compute capacity, ensuring no resource sharing at the CPU level.

The server is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. For external connectivity and data transfer, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

Utilizing Arm-based AWS Graviton processors, this bare-metal instance offers high resource density and power efficiency inherent to the arm64 architecture. The combination of 1.5 TB of RAM and 192 dedicated cores makes it suitable for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications requiring high memory capacity without the overhead of virtualization.
